method: Anonymous Node fetch --use-env-proxy; desktop UA for PC page and mobile UA otherwise; exact HTTPS host allowlist; manual redirects capped at 8; 25-second request timeout; 2-MiB response cap. No browser JavaScript, login, imported cookies, signatures, private APIs, or third-party parser services. _ROUTER_DATA read using quote-aware balanced JSON scanner and JSON.parse, never eval.
caveats: HTTP 200 and video IDs in URLs are not extraction success.
Media-key counts traverse successfully parsed state; marker presence alone is not evidence of playable resources.
Queries and fragments are removed from report URLs. Raw pages remain in work/phase3-research only and are excluded from source deliverables.
These observations apply only to this development machine/network. Device results may differ.
